name: ReadyGo Frequent Bundles – Frequently Bought Together & Product Bundles for WooCommerce
author: mkbplatinum

sections.description:
Raise your average order value the way the big stores do. ReadyGo Frequent Bundles for WooCommerce adds a “Frequently bought together” box to your product pages, showing the current product plus the items most often bought with it, with a running total and a single “Add selected to cart” button.

Best of all, it works automatically. The box fills itself from your own WooCommerce sales history, showing the products that genuinely appear in the same orders as each item. There is nothing to configure to get started, and you can still hand-pick a specific bundle for any product whenever you want.

Free, self-hosted, and no paid upgrade.

Built by ReadyGo Tools, a division of MKB Platinum.

Does WooCommerce have frequently bought together built in?

No. Core WooCommerce gives you plain up-sells and cross-sells, which are simple related-product lists a shopper has to click through and add one at a time. There is no bundled, ticked, one-click “buy these together” box and no automatic suggestion based on what actually sells together. This plugin adds exactly that.

How the automatic suggestions work

The plugin reads your completed WooCommerce orders and works out, for each product, which other products appear alongside it most often. That is real purchase data from your own store, not a guess and not an external service. As new orders come in the suggestions refresh, so the box gets smarter the longer your store runs. New stores with little order history can hand-pick bundles until the data builds up.

How to set up a frequently bought together bundle

For most stores the answer is that you do not have to. Activate the plugin and the box appears on product pages, filled from your sales history. When you do want control, open any product, go to the Linked Products tab, and choose the exact products to offer. Leave it empty and the plugin falls back to automatic suggestions, then to your existing up-sells.

Features

  • Automatic suggestions drawn from real sales history, refreshing as new orders arrive.
  • One-click bundle. The shopper ticks the items they want and adds them all to the cart at once.
  • Live running total that updates as items are ticked and unticked, so the shopper always sees what they are about to spend.
  • Hand-pick when you want. Override the automatic list per product from the Linked Products tab.
  • Sensible fallback order. Manual bundle first, then automatic suggestions, then your existing WooCommerce up-sells.
  • Fast and lightweight. Assets load only on product pages that actually show the box, and suggestions are cached rather than recalculated on every page view.
  • No AI, no scraping, no external services. Everything runs on your own site from your own data.

Why it lifts average order value

Cross-selling works when it is effortless and relevant. A related-products row asks the shopper to leave the page, evaluate a new product and start again. A frequently bought together box asks them to tick a box on a product they are already committed to buying, next to items other real customers bought at the same time. It is the lowest-friction upsell in ecommerce, which is why every large retailer runs one.

Built by ReadyGo Tools

Part of the ReadyGo Tools family of free WordPress plugins. Browse more at readygotools.com.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  2. Install and activate the plugin. The “Frequently bought together” box appears automatically on your product pages, populated from your sales history.
  3. (Optional) To hand-pick a bundle for a product, edit it, open the Linked Products tab, and choose items in the “Frequently bought together” field.
  4. Global options live under WooCommerce → Frequent Bundles.
sections.faq:
Do I have to set up the products manually?

No. By default the box fills itself automatically from your WooCommerce sales history — the products most often bought in the same orders as each item. You can override it per product in the Linked Products tab if you want a specific bundle.

Isn’t this already in WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce has up-sells and cross-sells (simple related-product lists), but not a bundled “Frequently bought together” box with checkboxes, a live total, and one-click add-to-cart. This plugin adds that.

How do the automatic suggestions stay up to date?

The ranking is cached for speed and refreshed automatically whenever a new order is paid, so newly co-purchased items appear without any manual work. Live price and stock are always re-checked on each page view.

How do I choose which products appear together myself?

Edit the main product, open the Linked Products tab, and pick them in the “Frequently bought together” field. Leaving it empty uses the automatic suggestions, then the product’s Up-sells.

Which product types are supported?

Simple products, for reliable one-click add-to-cart. Variable products are skipped to avoid ambiguous variation choices.

Does WooCommerce have a frequently bought together feature?

No. WooCommerce only offers up-sells and cross-sells, which are plain related-product lists. It has no bundled one-click box and no automatic suggestions based on real order data.

Do I have to build the bundles myself?

No. The box fills itself from your own WooCommerce sales history. You can override it per product if you want a specific bundle.

How do I create a frequently bought together bundle manually?

Edit the product, open the Linked Products tab, and choose the products to offer. Leave it empty to use automatic suggestions instead.

Will it work on a brand new store with no orders?

Automatic suggestions need order history to draw on. On a new store, hand-pick bundles from the Linked Products tab until enough orders accumulate.

Does it slow down my product pages?

No. Suggestions are cached rather than recalculated on each view, and front-end assets load only on product pages that actually display the box.

Can shoppers add only some of the suggested products?

Yes. Each item has its own tick box and the running total updates live, so the shopper adds exactly what they want in one click.

Is it really free?

Yes. There is no paid tier, no locked feature and no upsell nag inside the plugin.
sections.changelog:
0.4.1

  • Confirmed compatibility with WooCommerce 10.9 (tested up to).

0.4.0

  • Renamed the plugin to ReadyGo Frequent Bundles for WooCommerce. No change to features, settings, or stored data.

0.3.0

  • Added: Automatic suggestions — the box now fills itself from your sales history, showing the products most often bought together with each item. Refreshes automatically as new paid orders come in.
  • Added: Setting for how many products to show (1–10).
  • Manual selection in the Linked Products tab still overrides the automatic list; Up-sells remain the final fallback.

0.2.0

  • Added: Settings and Help & Support tabs with quick-start guide, FAQ, and support links.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: “Frequently bought together” box with live total and one-click add-to-cart, per-product selection with Up-sell fallback.
